import { MeshBasicNodeMaterial, PlaneGeometry } from 'three/webgpu';
import { uv, vec2, texture } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const { Group, Mesh, Color } = ctx.THREE;
  const group = new Group();

  const colorInk = new Color('#16161d');
  const colorPaper = new Color('#e8ecf2');
  const colorAccent = new Color('#ff2a38');
  const colorSurface = new Color('#0b0b10');

  // 1. STAGE BACKDROP (Designed for dark, gradient backdrop preventing void)
  const backdropGeo = new PlaneGeometry(7, 6);
  const backdropMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({ transparent: true, opacity: 0.9 });
  
  // Custom TSL vertical gradient (from surface near-black at bottom to ink at top)
  const customUV = uv();
  const gradientNode = customUV.y.mix(colorSurface, colorInk);
  backdropMat.colorNode = gradientNode;
  
  const backdropMesh = new Mesh(backdropGeo, backdropMat);
  backdropMesh.position.set(0, 0, -0.5);
  group.add(backdropMesh);

  // 2. SPRITE CARD
  // Source rect is 512x320. Sized to aspect ratio: 512/320 = 1.6
  const width = 2.4;
  const height = width / 1.6;
  const cardGeo = new PlaneGeometry(width, height);
  
  // UV calculation: Top-Left is (0,0), Bottom-Right is (512,320)
  // Assuming a 512x512 texture. 
  // U goes 0.0 -> 1.0 (512/512)
  // V goes (512-320)/512 -> 1.0 => 0.375 -> 1.0
  const uRange = vec2(0.0, 1.0);
  const vRange = vec2(0.375, 1.0);
  
  const cardMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({ transparent: true });
  // Initialize card color node with base solid before texture loads
  cardMat.colorNode = colorSurface;

  const timeline = gsap.timeline();

  if (config.imageUrl) {
    ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(config.imageUrl).then((tex) => {
      tex.colorSpace = 'srgb';
      // Crop texture node via TSL mapping based on the required sub-region
      const mappedUV = uv().mul(vRange.y.sub(vRange.x)).add(vec2(0.0, vRange.x));
      // Tint ceramic grain with paper color for refined texture finish
      cardMat.colorNode = texture(tex, mappedUV).mul(colorPaper);
      cardMat.needsUpdate = true;
    }).catch((err) => {
      console.warn("Failed loading textured sprite card:", err);
      cardMat.colorNode = colorSurface;
    });
  }

  const cardMesh = new Mesh(cardGeo, cardMat);
  group.add(cardMesh);

  // 3. TEXT CONTENT (Bimodal scale: 39px display translated to scene scales)
  const items = config.textContent ?? config.intent?.visualSpec?.textContent ?? [];
  const textStr = items[0]?.text ?? "Pricing 2";

  // Use the structured visualSpec metric (headline ~0.34)
  const textElement = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(textStr, {
    fontSize: 34,
    color: '#16161d', // Solid high-contrast ink atop paper surface texture
    align: 'center'
  });
  
  // Position text slightly in front to prevent depth fighting
  textElement.position.set(0, 0, 0.02);
  group.add(textElement);

  // 4. TRANSITIONS & ENTRANCE MOTION (Soft, weighted settle)
  group.position.y += 0.2;
  group.scale.set(0.96, 0.96, 0.96);
  
  timeline.to(group.position, {
    y: 0,
    duration: 0.9,
    ease: 'power3.out'
  });
  
  timeline.to(group.scale, {
    x: 1,
    y: 1,
    z: 1,
    duration: 0.9,
    ease: 'back.out(1.1)'
  }, 0);

  // 5. CLEANUP HANDLER
  group.userData.cleanup = () => {
    timeline.kill();
    cardGeo.dispose();
    cardMat.dispose();
    backdropGeo.dispose();
    backdropMat.dispose();
  };

  return group;
}
